description.value: Regional airline connecting Vancouver with smaller BC communities including Cranbrook (YXC), Castlegar (YCG), Trail (YZZ), Campbell River, Port Hardy, and others. Bikes ride in the cargo hold, in a rigid container (box) or unboxed with the handlebars turned sideways and pedals removed, at your own risk. You provide the packaging. E-bikes and e-scooters are not accepted. Fee $105 per direction; bike plus container max 70 lbs. Space is limited on the small aircraft.

Accommodates bicycles.detail: Bikes accepted: rigid container or unboxed w/ bars sideways + pedals off; $105/direction; max 70 lb; no e-bikes
